## Problem Statement
Long-term C/C++ maintainability depends on parser strategy and AST fidelity decisions.

## Tasks
- [ ] Compare parser candidates (capability, license, maintenance)
- [ ] Evaluate AST compatibility with engine abstraction
- [ ] Evaluate performance/memory impact
- [ ] Document tradeoffs and rejected alternatives
- [ ] Define fallback and migration strategy
- [ ] Publish ADR in docs and link from contributor guide

## Definition of Done
- [ ] Mentor-approved ADR with clear final decision
- [ ] Decision rationale references constraints and long-term impact

## Dependencies
None
